derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a reduplicated derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις) (compare G307 (ἀναβιβάζω));

occurrences.text: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
